The shingles vaccine. The vaccine, called Zostavax, is given as a single injection under the skin (subcutaneously). It can be given at any time in the year. Unlike with the flu jab, annual injections are not needed. It can be given at the same time as the flu jab in some cases to avoid additional appointments.
